headline: A 2016 law names a VA temporary lodging facility in Indianapolis the "Dr. Otis Bowen Veteran House."
what_it_does: This law renames a Department of Veterans Affairs temporary lodging facility in Indianapolis, Indiana. The new name is the "Dr. Otis Bowen Veteran House." It does not change how the facility operates or who can stay there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 14, 2016.
